question: Article 9(4) of Regulation (EU) 2022/2065 (Digital Services Act) provides that Member States’ Digital Services Coordinators shall, without undue delay, transmit a copy of each order to act against illegal content that is issued by judicial or administrative authorities. Two years after the adoption of the implementing regulation establishing the data-sharing platform between Member States and the Commission (AGORA) as a secure and reliable information exchange system between Digital Services Coordinators: 1.
Are national Digital Services Coordinators complying with the obligations of Article 9(4) by transmitting the relevant information to the data-sharing platform?
If so, which Member States are not complying with this obligation?

Depending on the analysis of the information shared on the data-sharing platform, has the Commission planned any measures to facilitate the protection of the fundamental rights most affected by unlawful conduct?
answer: EN on behalf of the European Commission (7.9.2026) The Commission cooperates with Digital Services Coordinators (DSCs) in the framework of the European Board for Digital Services (the Board) Working Group on orders and criminal issues1.

DSCs use the AGORA2 information-sharing platform, established under Article 85 of the Digital Services Act (DSA)3, to facilitate the transmission of orders received from national authorities to all other DSCs under Article 9(4) of the DSA.

The Commission is also working to enhance the user experience of AGORA and to strengthen its interoperability with national IT systems, with the aim of facilitating more efficient information exchange. The protection of fundamental rights is at the core of the DSA and of the related enforcement work.

Most recently, the Board, in cooperation with the Commission, has published its second annual report on systemic risks under the DSA4, which identifies systemic risks, such as the spread of illegal content or threats to fundamental rights, occurring on very large online platforms and gives an overview of the mitigation measures taken by platforms to counter such risks.
